verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser is primarily a law firm, but it ships its own AI product, Visalaw AI, so the natural-language axis applies. Marketing copy says the product drafts briefs, researches law, analyzes documents and automates workflows, and it shows prompt-style tasks plus a Research Agent. All of this comes from a landing page only, and the firm's core legal services are not shown to be operable this way. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the natural-language command interface and its scope, hands-on or independent corroboration, and evidence that actions beyond chat answers can be executed from natural language.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
